svg.metadata:
AlfaCode decorative cortex particle asset — MODIFIED DATA
alfacode-cortex.bin contains 16000 area-weighted surface samples, with normals and curvature shading, derived from the FreeSurfer fsaverage5 average cortical template as redistributed by Nilearn. Both hemispheres were resampled, centered, rotated, scaled and quantized for a decorative WebGL illustration. This modified asset is not the original surface dataset. No individual participant data are included. alfacode-cortex.svg is a simplified, shaded projection of those same surfaces.
Source: https://github.com/nilearn/nilearn/tree/4354a8f2aa9619743d1623a5166d3816ecaa7f5d/nilearn/datasets/data/fsaverage5 Files: pial_left.gii.gz, pial_right.gii.gz, curv_left.gii.gz, curv_right.gii.gz Generator: scripts/generate-landing-cortex.py SHA256: 967c5db1721fdcb8bdae2a3a4aefb5d643db44d1cd2b43d1fe1d7801a071e82a
